This post is just a **placeholder** so the blog isn't empty while it's wired up. Nothing here is published or searchable yet.

## How to add real posts

Each post is one entry in `blog.json`. Copy this block and fill it in:

```
{
  "slug": "my-post-url",
  "title": "My post title",
  "date": "2026-08-12",
  "tags": ["environment art", "process"],
  "excerpt": "One line that shows on the list.",
  "cover": "images/gameography/starship-troopers.jpg",
  "body": "Markdown goes here."
}
```

The `body` is plain **Markdown** — headings with `#`, `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `- lists`, `> quotes`, `[links](https://example.com)`, `![images](path.jpg)`, and fenced code. Newest posts sort to the top automatically by `date`.

## Pulling from ArtStation

Your ArtStation blog lives at [artstation.com/mikicompany/blog](https://www.artstation.com/mikicompany/blog). Once the posts are copied in here, delete this placeholder entry and you're live (on the arcade only — still not searchable).
